_comment: Telegram Guest Mode rules (hot-reloaded). Place at $OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR/hotfix-guest-ack.json (default ~/.openclaw of the gateway user) or point OPENCLAW_HOTFIX_GUEST_ACK_FILE at it. enabled:false restores the v1.1.x behaviour (single answerGuestQuery, no placeholder/edit/append/media). mediaStagingChatId must be set before guests can receive files (a chat the bot can post to; a copy of each file stays there).
